game.q: an old buddhist name for a mind that swings from thought to thought? it’s…

wrong.tabs: accurate. but the old name has a monkey in it.
wrong.beginner: a real zen word, but that one’s open, not stuck.

game.right: YES. monkey mind, leaping branch to branch. ekido’s spent all afternoon on one branch.

end.line: tanzan carried her across the mud and set her down. ekido carried her all day.
end.l2: the other carried her all day.
